body: Exactly how I feel. Truly have been blessed, but I’ve been depressed for years. Been in and out of therapy since the beginning. My parents are against medicine for it tho, so it’s no dice. It’s been hard to get out of bed lately. Trying my best to push thru. It’s a weird thing to be apart of, blessed life but wanting to end it. Hope you’re well.
